entry.title: Twelve checkpoints close the scoring gap
entry.summary: V6 and V7 now have twelve checkpoint scores on the same 7,057-target development panel. The final scores improve slightly, the curves remain uneven, and reasoning is still unmeasured.

entry.title: V6 completes; V7 starts while quality remains unmeasured
entry.summary: V6 finished 44,759,442 valid labels. Completion recovery passed, but the CFR readiness gate failed before scoring. V7 is running; no new quality or reasoning result exists.

entry.title: V6 begins with a saved checkpoint, not a new quality score
entry.summary: V5 is complete. V6 has a first saved checkpoint after 7,487,125 valid labels; no new language or reasoning score has been measured.

entry.title: A second completed slice and V5 completion
entry.summary: The second V4 slice and V5 both completed. Same-panel CFR perplexity fell across both slices, with one retained checkpoint regression. Reasoning improvement remains unproven.

entry.title: A completed slice and an uneven loss curve
entry.summary: The first V4 slice completed 111.46M valid labels. Terminal CFR perplexity 37.7860 is below the parent but worse than the preceding checkpoint. The next slice is running; a format diagnostic stopped at its CPU readiness gate.

entry.title: Fourth checkpoint on the next corpus slice
entry.summary: Checkpoint 2,273 scores CFR perplexity 38.1737 on the same 7,057-label development set. All four saved checkpoints remain visible, including checkpoint 1,705's small regression. No new broader or logic score has run.

entry.title: Second checkpoint on the next corpus slice
entry.summary: At update 1,137, CFR development perplexity is 38.5124: down 3.1774% from the matching parent baseline and 2.4336% from checkpoint 569. Broader and logic evaluations have not run at this checkpoint.

entry.title: First checkpoint on the next corpus slice
entry.summary: The first V4 checkpoint scores CFR perplexity 39.4730 versus the matching parent baseline of 39.7762. Intermediate checkpoint and evaluation hooks occupy 3.413% of loop time; transferable logic remains unestablished.

entry.title: Two training stages complete: terminal language and protocol checks
entry.summary: Both stages complete. Terminal CFR perplexity is 39.7762; a separate mixed-source panel reaches 14.6312. Fixed32 returns 0/32 correct and protocol-valid, leaving reasoning capacity unresolved.

entry.title: Checkpoint metrics after larger one-pass training phases
entry.summary: The 299M model completes a 130.07M-label stage with six measured checkpoints. Its next stage is running; saved checkpoint 3,316 reaches CFR perplexity 39.6483 after the earlier regression at 1,990. These are narrow development-language results, not a new reasoning score.

entry.title: Completing the first admitted arXiv continuation pilot
entry.summary: A bounded infrastructure pilot completes one pass over 99 admitted arXiv papers: 62 updates and 2,029,534 valid labels. All three logic probes return 0/32 correct and 0/32 protocol-valid answers. New-phase language loss is unmeasured; broader corpus admission continues.

entry.title: Measuring language loss after 299M recovery
entry.summary: Across five checkpoints, loss on a fixed regulatory-prose development set falls 6.49% from baseline to terminal. Logic probes stay at 0/32 correct and 0/32 protocol-valid. The 62-update arXiv continuation remains prepared and unrun.

entry.title: Qualifying a 299M model and counting the next training phase
entry.summary: A fresh 299M model completes qualification and begins a finite pretraining phase. The first update is recorded and its checkpoint independently verified; broader corpus candidates remain unadmitted.

entry.title: Clarifying the goal, storage, and corpus readiness
entry.summary: The first guarded measurement and storage fixtures completed, and Linux integration checks passed. Corpus admission remains closed; a small engineering probe is being prepared.

entry.title: Recovering completed work before broader pretraining
entry.summary: A fresh audit recovers completed dialogue scoring and all 25 primary HTML responses. The original base is preserved, while corpus admission and independent prose validation still block broader pretraining.

entry.title: Document review narrows the validation candidates
entry.summary: Nineteen dialogue candidates remain after record review, but none are admitted. Book extraction and arXiv version checks show why archive metadata cannot establish usable training yield.

entry.title: Reflection did not repair the failures; corpus inspection is not admission
entry.summary: Three reflections produced no actionable diagnosis, and independent review found zero complete outcomes in nine assisted retries. Nine language samples and three inspected source files expose separate capability and data-admission limits.

entry.title: Reflect on saved failures, then test broader pretraining
entry.summary: A bounded reflection diagnostic will test possible repairs to three saved failures before a conditional comparison of broader base training. Neither intervention has results at this planning milestone.

entry.title: More distinct supervision did not produce a better planning assistant
entry.summary: The matched diversity study finishes without a promoted checkpoint. Fresh examples improve one reused diagnostic but lose on the new set, training fit, and retained calendar behavior.

entry.title: Testing more distinct examples at matched training exposure
entry.summary: A new study matches realized assistant-label exposure while varying repair-anchor diversity. Both finite training arms finish; evaluation remains a separate decision gate.

entry.title: More correct task fields, but more wrong-object writes
entry.summary: Varied task values improve nine of 64 requested outcomes versus three for repetition, but increase wrong-object writes and false claims. Neither checkpoint is promoted.

entry.title: Launching a matched repetition control for task binding
entry.summary: Two fresh-base arms compare repeated task-repair controls with varied values. Preflight catches overlap before the data freeze, and exact label budgets are recorded.

entry.title: Testing input-to-action binding with a repetition control
entry.summary: The next hypothesis targets requested objects and values. A repetition control will separate varied supervision from simply adding more task-repair examples.

entry.title: Varied training years did not produce date transfer
entry.summary: The year-diversity candidate still fails unseen years and loses retained behavior. Valid tool syntax and some improved date fields do not justify promotion.

entry.title: Testing whether varied training years improve date transfer
entry.summary: A matched supervised-training experiment varies years while preserving token counts and conversation order. Fresh year diagnostics are frozen before training.

entry.title: Paired probes isolate date and identifier failures
entry.summary: Changing a year or target identifier breaks otherwise successful requests. Longer training improves some ordering cases while false completion claims increase.

entry.title: Longer canonical training improves fit but not development planning
entry.summary: The same 64 training cases fit better after two million supervised labels, while development behavior still fails. Fewer completion claims also conceal more unfinished conversations.

entry.title: Testing a longer optimization budget on canonical supervision
entry.summary: A fresh two-million-label run tests whether more optimization improves familiar-example fit. Exposure and schedule change together; no new development result is claimed at launch.

entry.title: Canonical serialization leaves planning failures unresolved
entry.summary: Aligned training and runtime histories remove a measurement confound, but the canonical 500K run still fails to produce reliable plans. Familiar-example fit and development behavior are reported separately.

entry.title: A controlled test of training tool serialization
entry.summary: The canonical 500K-label experiment starts from the preserved base with matched configuration and assistant targets. This launch snapshot makes no completed-performance claim.

entry.title: Repairing tool serialization before the next run
entry.summary: A separate training derivative aligns tool-message representation with the runtime. Stronger date and outcome audits qualify the earlier proxy scores before more compute.

entry.title: Broader supervision exposes scoring and input-format limits
entry.summary: The finite paired pilot finishes, but its apparent development gains do not establish correct plans. Follow-up checks find incomplete fitting and a tool-serialization mismatch.

entry.title: Broader supervision, with failures kept in the record
entry.summary: A larger owned supervision set passes bounded data and context checks. The next comparison tests broader coverage without treating training fit as planning ability.

entry.title: Validation sensitivity after the overlap audit
entry.summary: Two frozen filters raise loss on changed validation populations. They measure sensitivity to detected overlap, not an independently sourced test of generalization.

entry.title: The first planning comparison failed
entry.summary: Both matched models fail all 80 development cases. Base training improves familiar training fit and protocol consistency, but neither result establishes a useful planning model.

entry.title: Auditing overlap across the textbook split
entry.summary: A bounded lexical audit finds strong overlap candidates involving 42 validation documents. Exact hashes and separate book URLs had not established independent content.

entry.title: The first 100 million base-training tokens
entry.summary: The model completes 100 million valid training-token exposures and preserves a verified checkpoint. Language-model loss improves, while conversational transfer and validation independence remain separate questions.

entry.title: A bounded news-source audit during base training
entry.summary: A bounded scan identifies 1,426 candidate articles for possible later study. Source correspondence and software integrity checks do not establish training eligibility.

entry.title: Queueing the matched comparison
entry.summary: A reviewed sequential pipeline waits for the base checkpoint, then plans a bounded language probe, isolated supervised smoke test, matched training branches, and development evaluations.

entry.title: Making the planning comparison fair
entry.summary: Exact supervised budgets, a stronger symbolic reference, a separate policy check, and a corrected context reserve prepare a comparison of random and base-trained weights.

entry.title: Freezing the planning world and correcting the evaluation
entry.summary: Review exposed weaknesses in completion checking and the original language split. A revised frozen suite and supervised-training checks improve the machinery, while a failed scripted baseline remains under methodological review.

entry.title: The first real-text GPU run
entry.summary: A two-million-token pilot finishes in 137.238 seconds with lower held-out loss and a verified checkpoint. The larger 100-million-token continuation remains in progress.

entry.title: A real corpus and a fresh tokenizer
entry.summary: A bounded textbook corpus yields 26.91 million training tokens and a fresh 16,384-token BPE vocabulary. The license evidence and limits of the split are recorded explicitly.

entry.title: Testing the deadline guard before long training
entry.summary: Eight Linux guard tests and a short dummy-checkpoint job verify bounded shutdown behavior. A frozen behavioral suite is recorded, but model evaluation has not run.

entry.title: A 120-hour plan for a small conversational model
entry.summary: A fixed five-day experiment proposes a fresh tokenizer, roughly 100 million base-training tokens, and separate tests of model behavior and guarded tool use. These are plans and release goals, not results.

entry.title: An isolated environment and the first bounded GPU diagnostic
entry.summary: A 97.5M-parameter model passes six correctness checks and a short Radeon 8060S benchmark, with explicit limits on what those results demonstrate.

entry.title: Access, resource inventory, and setup status
entry.summary: A read-only inventory establishes the starting point for a small model experiment: capable hardware, occupied GPU memory, and an unverified training environment.
